key.name: size-scale
key.description: Scales the width of the expanded capsule.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the capsule in pixels.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: How opaque the capsule background is.

key.name: animation-speed
key.description: Multiplier for the speed of all capsule animations.

key.name: open-on-hover
key.description: Open the capsule when the pointer rests on it. If off, it opens on click only.

key.name: auto-collapse
key.description: Close the expanded capsule shortly after the pointer leaves it.

key.name: activities-in-collapsed
key.summary: Show activities in the collapsed capsule
key.description: Show a running timer, music or an upcoming meeting instead of the time while collapsed.

key.name: enabled-widgets
key.description: The widgets shown in the expanded capsule.
